decision: Isolate cadence selection for the existing exact-tail executor in a KDE module and reuse existing bounded fast emitters only for the resolved KDE backend with an actual X11 virtual device. Other desktops and evdev retain original paced functions.

verification: Pre-edit dependency map and consequence analysis; preserve existing executor statements and guard/order proofs with mechanical cadence-call substitutions only; reuse unchanged bounded emission code; targeted daemon source checks and warning-free release build; unchanged native three-case RED/GREEN, then full Firefox and existing-route KDE controls after short PASS.
not_tested: No new GNOME, Wayland or USB acceptance is implied. Post-output unavailable field receipts and the earlier pre-layout cancellation are separate unresolved observations. A visible native PASS does not certify those backend receipts.
experiment_verdict: REJECTED: native short check 1 PASS / 2 FAIL; all source checks passed but repeat gestures lost context authority. Original daemon and source restored; do not remove pacing again without new settlement evidence.
